charts.name: leak-fix-classifier
charts.title: Classifier accuracy with leaked (v3) and clean (v4) features
charts.subtitle: Private intraday run, reported metrics exported once; both leaks fixed together in v4
charts.alt: 5-minute classifier accuracy is 74.4 percent with leaked features and 49.9 percent with clean features. 10-minute accuracy is 73 percent and 49.8 percent.

charts.name: leak-fix-regression
charts.title: Regression directional accuracy with leaked (v3) and clean (v4) features
charts.subtitle: Same private run; the metric is named directional_accuracy in the export
charts.alt: 5-minute regression directional accuracy is 73.7 percent with leaked features and 50.8 percent with clean features. 10-minute is 72.5 percent and 50.2 percent.

charts.name: resample-future-reads
charts.title: Share of bars whose 5-minute bucket feature reads a later close
charts.subtitle: Synthetic bars, 2 sessions per condition, seed 0. 1-min gaps: 1-minute bars with 10% removed
charts.source: claude-skills docs/data.json chart future-reads, regenerated with python examples/lookahead_demo.py at 85d2aee
charts.alt: The leaky bucket pattern reads a later close on 80, 77.3 and 90 percent of bars. The row-count shift reads none on 1-minute bars with or without gaps and 40 percent on 30-second bars. The previous-bucket variant reads none in all three conditions.
